div.p: I, Asa Owen Aldis, of St. Albans, in the county of Franklin and State of Vermont, one of the judges of the supreme court of the State of Vermont, and chief judge of the county court of the county of Franklin and State of Vermont, hereby certify that Joseph H. Brainerd, whose signature is appended and subscribed to the above certificate, is the clerk of the said county court of the county of aforesaid; that I am well acquainted with and know the signature of the said Franklin Brainerd, and the seal of the said county clerk; that the signature subscribed to the above certificate is the genuine signature of the said Joseph H. Brainerd, and the seal affixed to the said certificate is the seal of the said county court of the county of Franklin aforesaid; that the said court is a common law court of record; that the said Brainerd, as clerk of the said county court, has the custody of the record of all commissions issued to justices of the peace acting within and for the county of Franklin aforesaid.

closer.dateline: In testimony whereof, I have hereunto set my hand at St. Albans, in the comity of Franklin aforesaid, this twenty-first day of October, in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and sixty-four.
